Context: 9. Extraordinary Pension

Category 'E'.Death or disability arising as a result of (a) attack by or during action against extremists, antisocial elements, etc. and (b) enemy action in international war or border skirmishes and warlike situations, including cases which are attributable to (i) extremists acts, exploding mines, etc., while on· way to an operational area, (ii) kidnapping by extremists, and (iii) battleinoculation as part of training exercises with live ammunition.
